method: Fresh prepare/design on 55 fixed native masks, alternating arm order. Baseline replaces fit.js and refine.js with their preceding 53d6bf6 versions; all other current code and inputs are identical. One pair per mask. Solve timings include preparation but exclude independent rendering, editable conversion and file writes.
qualifications: Fixed-mask replay does not rerun cropping. The historical nested-squares and santa no-crop failures remain outside the 29-photo-mask cohort; its 27/29 result does not improve the full 27/31 photo result.

Checked template status requires source features and configured image agreement as well as geometry/paper checks. It does not establish equality to unavailable cutting ground truth or physical assembly.
All fourteen changed geometry pairs were visually reviewed. Existing false seams, rounded joins and border defects remain; low disagreement is not a claim of perfect reconstruction.

Seven higher errors are retained. None of those seven reports contains a recovered-route refinement, the caller that supplies the new repair deadline. Ordinary wall-clock-bounded refinement/sharing differs between runs; this comparison does not isolate the small changes as benefits or regressions caused by the new branch.

The half-star candidate reaches a later checkpoint as well as completing its repair. Earlier repeated prototypes, a clock diagnostic and fixed-clock regression tests provide separate evidence for the repair mechanism.
